astranl.use_when: an estimate you created has materials and you want to know whether their prices or stock changed before ordering

annotations.title: Check the materials of an estimate

description: Check every material line of an AstraNL estimate case you hold the token of (from estimate_case_create) against the current offer of the same product: PRICE_UP or PRICE_DOWN beyond 5 percent, UNAVAILABLE, NOT_FOUND_IN_CHECKED_SOURCES, CHEAPER_SAME_GTIN at another store, each with source and read time, plus the open findings of the daily monitor for that case. Read-only; an estimate is re-read live at most once in 6 hours.
name: check_estimate_materials
